s2.ownedStunDuration: INFINITY while blocked in S2 mode

verificationLimits: All30 source ranks, full native components, original templates, and both actual animator-to-skeleton chains are retained. Modules, Unity particles/audio, exact damage/controller priority and game-frame parity remain unsupported.

Native no-SP trait uses an SP_MODIFY_STOPPED flag and a Block checker. The adapter stops unforced gifts as well as natural recovery when no alive current blockee exists. Initial SP remains permitted. Block hooks update immediately; loss-of-block cleanup and stun detachment are bounded to the simulator tick phase. Do not infer natural SP only.

Peerless Bravery uses the original .1-second first-waiting sample, LE half-HP threshold, and mutually exclusive damage/Sanctuary states. The pre-mitigation hit hook bridges ON_CALCULATE_DAMAGE; exact native priority and initial first-trigger phase remain unverified. Ordinary Sanctuary does not reduce True damage or HP loss.

S2 Block Checker supplies infinite-duration stun to its blockees while the mode is active. The adapter respects immunity and isolates owned instances so end, withdrawal or unblock remove only its own stun. Current-Block target caps preserve minimum1 and reselect at the literal hit event. Exact native blockee-change/override/cleanse dispatch and same-frame removal order remain bounded.

S3 is a sequential Hensin -> SwitchMode cast. Hensin contains the stat buff and native immunes0/16/12 and forces Front. The actual Front Begin is1.5seconds with no OnAttack event; local continuation uses its completion on a fixed1x clock, then runs the selected-duration mode. This startup clock, duration origin, interruption dispatch and early-stat ownership are explicit simulator interpretations; native eventless continuation has not been executed or recovered. Podenco silence and Gnosis frozen selector fields retain numeric mapping context.

The transformation immunity is limited to local Begin; normal mecha mode is not immune. Native Front-only mode/Idle/Die bindings are preserved without inventing missing Back clips. End blend uses actual .667 Front clip while the source post-mode stun lasts its selected duration. Precise blend and cooldown overlap remain bounded.
All old operator/token/stage/enemy records and source/SD pins remain unchanged. Original SD models already exist in the asset catalogue; art alone does not enable an operator.
